decisions.reason: Its award-backed launch and very strong fit with the firm's core organic yogurt business make it likely to remain above aspiration levels despite the lack of recent website evidence.
Because management initially framed it as a flagship cheese direction, boundedly rational decision makers would be reluctant to abandon it unless sales clearly fell below aspirations.

After several years with no renewed positive signal, this relatively undifferentiated adjacent cheese is the kind of product management would prune if it failed to stand out against aspiration levels.
A multi-variant spicy cheese line suggests a larger prior resource commitment, so with no direct evidence of failure the firm would more likely continue it while narrowing attention if needed.

This soft-cheese extension fits the portfolio but lacks later supporting signals, so if its results were merely middling management would reallocate resources to stronger core products or new projects.
As the most niche offering here, a washed-rind soft cheese is most exposed to falling short of aspiration levels, and limited slack would make discontinuation the likelier choice by 2022.
